challenge.title: The challenge in KSA
challenge.body: Most organizations have more data than ever but struggle to turn it into decisions. Data sits in silos, AI pilots never reach production, and sensitive data cannot leave the Kingdom for public AI services.
points: Data spread across systems that do not talk to each other
AI proofs of concept that stall before production
Residency rules that rule out many public AI services
Few in-house data and machine-learning specialists

opportunity.title: The opportunity
opportunity.body: The National Strategy for Data & AI targets major investment and thousands of new specialists by 2030. Organizations that build governed data foundations and production AI now will lead their sectors.
